root_idea.summary: The root denotes cutting, severing, or separation.
root_idea.development: The basic idea of cutting extends to severed produce, broken relations, things or periods coming to an end, firm decisions that cut off alternatives, and qualities associated with a sharp sword.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Normalized from the imperfect QAC lemma to the Form I perfect citation form.
Presented under the singular active-participle citation form.
Normalized to the indefinite dictionary citation form صَرِيمٌ.

senses.definition: To cut off or harvest the fruit of a tree or crop.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quranic construction, the object is the produce of the garden; the imperfect form refers to the intended harvesting.

senses.definition: Intent on cutting off or harvesting the fruit.
senses.usage_conditions: Used of those determined to carry out the cutting or harvesting of the garden's produce.
In the Quranic description, the garden is compared to the dark night, especially after being burned and blackened.

senses.definition: A garden or land whose produce has been cut off or reaped.
senses.usage_conditions: The expression can describe a garden stripped of its fruit or crops; this is an alternative Quranic interpretation of the passage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To cut, cut through, cut off, or sever something.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A general physical cutting verb, including the separation of a rope, date cluster, tree, crop, or similar object.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To break off relations, abandon someone, or sever friendly intercourse; to separate from one another.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Includes reciprocal severance and the breaking of a bond of union.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To decide or resolve an affair.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative extension of cutting off alternatives or attachments.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become severed, separate, or come to an end.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of objects that become cut apart and of night, winter, a year, or fighting when it ends; it can also describe withdrawal from people.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To stay, stop, or tarry for a period.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An independently attested usage, including staying with someone for a month.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Sharp and unbending, especially of a sword.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The participle is also used substantivally or adjectivally of a sword.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Hardy, strong, vigorous, penetrating, effective, and courageous.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied to a person by comparison with a sharp sword; it can also describe acquired endurance or hardiness.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To cut repeatedly, extensively, or into many pieces; to become so cut or severed.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Form II emphasizes the extent or multiplicity of the cutting, while the quasi-passive form describes the resulting condition.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The time or season when palm fruit is cut or ripens for cutting.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: أَصْرَمَ النخلَ refers to the palms reaching or approaching their cutting season.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Poor or possessing only a small amount of property.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The usage is associated with a person whose remaining property or camel herd is small, sometimes alongside a large household.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Skin or leather.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This noun is reported as an Arabicized loanword and is lexically distinct from the ordinary cutting noun.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A small encampment or company of people settled apart with their camels.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: It may refer to a few separate tents or to the group inhabiting them.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A seller of soled boots.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized lexical usage connected with the word for a soled leather boot.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A person slow to return from anger.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used as a substantivized epithet for someone who does not readily relent.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A detached herd or group of camels.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The reported size varies by authority; the diminutive صُرَيْمَةٌ denotes a smaller detached group.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A detached portion of property or a separated mass of clouds.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The common idea is a portion separated from a larger aggregate.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Palm trees themselves, by association with the cutting of their fruit.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A metonymic usage attested in traditional expression.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Fruit cut from palm trees.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Refers to the harvested produce rather than the season or act of harvesting.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The last milk remaining in an udder and drawn in necessity; figuratively, the final exhausted resource or limit.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The figurative sense occurs in a proverb about an excuse or matter reaching its utmost point.

other_classical_meanings.definition: War, battle, or a calamity.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The word is used conventionally for a destructive conflict or misfortune.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A she-camel that separates herself from the other camels and does not approach the watering place until left alone.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The isolation is the defining behavioral feature of this animal term.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Cut or severed; specifically, produce or a heap of grain whose produce has been cut off, or an ear cut off entirely.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A nominal/adjectival usage distinct from the Quranic comparison of the garden to darkness or reaped land.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Disappointed, despairing, or wearied and eager in pursuit of an affair.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Occurs in the idiom جَاءَ صَرِيمَ سَحَرٍ and related expressions.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A decision, determination, or firm resolution, together with its effective execution.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: It may also denote the object or objective upon which one has firmly resolved.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Daybreak or dawn.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The term is explained as dawn because it is cut off from the night; the same headword is also used for night in a contrasting conventional sense.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Black land that produces nothing.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized description of barren, dark ground.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A stick placed across a young animal's mouth and tied to its head to prevent suckling.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A practical animal-husbandry term.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Land whose seed crop has been reaped.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The form is a feminine derivative with passive-result meaning.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A detached portion or large mass of sand.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: It can describe a separate sand heap or detached sand formation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A group or detached assemblage of certain trees, including ghadhā, salam, arṭā, samar, or palms.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A collective term for trees gathered or standing as a detached group.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A person who follows his own judgment and acts with penetrating, vigorous effectiveness.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used as an epithet derived from the qualities of decisive severance and energetic execution.

other_classical_meanings.definition: One who cuts, cuts through, or severs.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A general active-participle usage, broader than the Quranic construction concerning the fruit harvest.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The lion.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative designation based on the lion's force and ability to sever or overcome.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A calamity that extirpates or destroys everything.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized intensive noun for an utterly destructive event.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Firmness or soundness of judgment.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized abstract or descriptive usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A single meal eaten once in the day.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The term is explained through the idea that eating it cuts off further eating for the day.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A man whose ear extremity has been cut off.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A bodily descriptive noun.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A she-camel whose milk supply has been cut off, especially through cutting or cauterizing the teats or their passages.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The resulting lack of milk is associated with strengthening or treating the animal.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A waterless desert or tract with no water.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A geographic descriptive noun.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The wolf and the crow, or, in another conventional pairing, the night and the day.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The pair is named for the separation of each member from people or from the other member.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A narrow place or channel through which water flows quickly.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The name is explained by the flow being quickly cut off from the place.

other_classical_meanings.definition: One who possesses a small detached herd of camels.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The derived noun can also refer more generally to a person of little property.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The curved knife used by a maker or parer of spindles.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized tool term.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A preparer or seller of skin or leather.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A professional designation derived from the specialized noun صَرْمٌ for leather.

cautions: صَرِيمٌ in 68:20 has materially distinct attested interpretations: night-like darkness and a garden whose produce has been cut off; the form is therefore given two Quranic senses.
The Quranic active-participle occurrence is plural in the text, but the public headword is normalized to the singular citation form صَارِمٌ.

One Lane claim for صِرْمٌ meaning a kind or sort is retained as ambiguous because the source itself indicates a likely transcription error; the similarly qualified silver-portion claim is likewise not assigned as a firm meaning.
unassigned_or_ambiguous_evidence: lane-unit:Srm:25886:g1:sub2 reports صِرْمٌ as meaning a kind or sort, but the source notes that this may be a mistranscription for صِرْبٌ.
lane-unit:Srm:25887:g2:main reports a portion of melted silver while explicitly warning that the headword may be a mistranscription.
